+import { setTimeout as sleep } from 'node:timers/promises'
+
+import type { CaptureResult, GatewayClient } from '../gateway/client.js'
+import { logger } from '../log.js'
+
+export interface RetryPolicy {
+  maxAttempts: number
+  baseDelayMs: number
+  maxDelayMs: number
+}
+
+export const DEFAULT_POLICY: RetryPolicy = { maxAttempts: 5, baseDelayMs: 250, maxDelayMs: 8_000 }
+
+const RETRYABLE = new Set(['gateway_timeout', 'rate_limited', 'conflict'])
+
+/** Captures one authorized payment, retrying transient gateway failures with capped exponential backoff. */
+export async function captureWithRetry(
+  gateway: GatewayClient,
+  paymentId: string,
+  amountMinor: number,
+  policy: RetryPolicy = DEFAULT_POLICY,
+): Promise<CaptureResult> {
+  let attempt = 0
+  for (;;) {
+    attempt += 1
+    const result = await gateway.capture({ paymentId, amountMinor })
+    if (result.ok) return result
+    if (!RETRYABLE.has(result.error.code) || attempt >= policy.maxAttempts) {
+      logger.warn({ paymentId, attempt, code: result.error.code }, 'capture failed')
+      return result
+    }
+    const delay = Math.min(policy.maxDelayMs, policy.baseDelayMs * 2 ** (attempt - 1))
+    await sleep(delay)
+  }
+}

+

+const ok: CaptureResult = { ok: true, capturedAt: '2026-11-10T09:00:00.000Z' }
+
+function scripted(results: CaptureResult[]): GatewayClient & { calls: number } {
+  const client = {
+    calls: 0,
+    async capture() {
+      return results[Math.min(client.calls++, results.length - 1)]!
